newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - AUG 15.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - AUG 15.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- The Prime Ministers of Hungary and Slovakia have begun talks in Gyor, north Hungary.
- Police caught car thieves who stole luxury cars during the Formula One race last weekend.
- The Budapest city council granted four billion forints for the refurbishment of 10 homes for the aged.
- The Hungarian Chamber for Industry and Trade disapproves the government's taxation plans.
- The Budapest bourse reflects the improvement of the Hungarian economy.
